About

I am an undergraduate student at the University of Waterloo. My work combines practical web development with an interest in empirical software engineering. I am building a foundation in computer science and mathematics while learning how to frame and investigate research questions.

Current interests

Research

I am interested in AI agent skills as a software artifact and in methods for studying their reuse and quality. Questions I am exploring include:

  • How do skills spread and evolve across repositories?
  • What can repository history tell us beyond exact content matches?
  • Which measurable signals are useful when evaluating skill quality?
